name: @fluidinference/text-processing-rs
description: Inverse Text Normalization (ITN) — convert spoken-form ASR output to written form

scripts.wasm:build:node: wasm-pack build --release --target nodejs --features wasm && mkdir -p pkg-node && cp -f pkg/* pkg-node/ && node scripts/set-wasm-package-name.mjs pkg-node
scripts.wasm:build:web: wasm-pack build --release --target web --features wasm && mkdir -p pkg-web && cp -f pkg/* pkg-web/ && node scripts/set-wasm-package-name.mjs pkg-web
scripts.wasm:ci: npm run wasm:build:node && npm run wasm:test:node && npm run wasm:build:web
